name: read-units-layer
description: A layer-granularity `read` of `units`, one of the three layers contract `8.0.0` added for the forms a type names by reference, stored in `data_types/units/`. It answers the one unit the model declares — by its `name` alone, since a summary leaves out the optional `display_name` — and nothing of the two elements that name it: a reference is a field of its referrer, not a member of the layer it targets. One of three layer reads of one model, one per element layer.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model plus contract `8.0.0`'s data description elements: the unit `ProbeNewtonMetre` (`data_types/units/`), the linear compu method `ProbeTorqueScale` naming it and the texttable `ProbeGearTable` with two entries (`data_types/compu_methods/`), and the data constraint `ProbeTorqueLimits` (`data_types/constraints/`); the application type `ProbeTorque` names the unit, the method and the constraint, and the enumeration `ProbeGear` and the value type `ProbeGearRaw` (over the base's `uint8_base`) share the table.
context.notes: No `form` is stated, so a layer address answers its default, `summary`. The same model is read at the other two element layers by `read-compu-methods-layer` and `read-data-constraints-layer`, and one of its compu methods by `read-compu-methods-texttable-element`.

expected.notes: A unit is named by an application type's `unit_ref` and by a linear compu method's `unit`; both resolve in this layer alone.
